Script verifies 789355 local classifications, 35 modular counts, and 340 generating-function coefficients; independent symbolic proof covers all r.

value.rationale: Duffy et al. establish eventual periodicity for stars and motivate quantitative chip questions but provide no recurrent-state enumeration. The exact all-r conserved-total count and its signed one-orbit residue anomaly are a natural structural refinement; the nonnegative series gives physically meaningful exact counts and minimum total. The value does not rest on computer enumeration or on a routine small-case increment.
